title: Design tokens are bypassed widely and the brand colour is inconsistent
standards: DECISIONS.md 2026-10-16 (globals.css is the single source of theme tokens)
steps: grep counts over 350 frontend source files (commands recorded in evidence).
expected: Colours, layers and spacing come from the tokens in globals.css; one brand colour family.
actual: 2,298 raw Tailwind palette classes vs 3,585 semantic token classes (≈ 39% bypass), led by amber (692), red (312), blue (265), emerald (173). 100 distinct hard-coded hex colours in TS/TSX, 74 inline style colour props, 8 arbitrary colour values. Ad-hoc z-index values from z-[65] to z-[2147483647]. The manifest theme and landing use blue/violet while in-app accents are amber/gold.
impact: Dark mode and contrast fixes must be made in hundreds of places; inconsistent look between landing and app; layering bugs between overlays (tour, splash, dialogs).
fix: Add semantic tokens for brand, success, warning, info and a z-index scale to globals.css; codemod raw palette classes to tokens page by page; add an ESLint rule (e.g. no raw palette classes outside ui/) to stop new ones.
